population.basis: Great-circle distance from native population pixel centres to station coordinates; union without double counting.

catchments.interpretation: Radial station-access sensitivity; barriers and entrance paths unverified.

population.denominator: Sum of valid native population-count pixels inside the city bounding box; no scaling to catalogue population.
limitations: Population year/boundary differs from the catalogue; counts are not current census counts.
Radial access can overstate walking access across rivers, motorways, walls or steep terrain.
No fare demand, unique passengers, feeder revenue or funding improvement is inferred.
